recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色低倍下，陽性細胞聚集成彼此相連、形狀不規則的蛇行狀或模糊結節帶，與陰性小淋巴球區交錯分布，並散在環狀陽性結構，顯示 NLPHL 中不典型（serpiginous/interconnected）的結節型態。
features: Positive cells concentrated in ill-defined, interconnected serpiginous nodular bands
Intervening broad zones of negative small lymphocytes
Positive cells small to intermediate with membranous red staining; scattered ring-like larger positive profiles
No sharply circumscribed follicles or mantle zones
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification; antibody identity not labeled
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low power shows positive cells aggregated in ill-defined, interconnected serpiginous bands and vague nodules, separated by broad zones of negative small lymphocytes. Scattered ring-like positive profiles are present within the positive zones, but individual cytology cannot be assessed at this magnification. No sharply circumscribed follicles with mantle zones are recognized. In a case of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, this appearance fits a serpiginous/interconnected nodular or extranodular variant pattern; the specific marker and correlation with CD20, CD3, PD-1 and CD21 staining are required for interpretation.

ddx.vs: PTGC forms discrete, round, enlarged nodules of small B cells amid reactive follicles, not interconnected serpiginous bands with LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma shows back-to-back rounded follicles of BCL2+ CD10+ cells rather than irregular serpiginous zones.
Nodular LRCHL can mimic this architecture, but its large cells are CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells within expanded mantle zones.
THRLBCL lacks nodular or serpiginous B-cell compartments and has a purely diffuse T-cell-rich background.
